Head of Finance
Melsta Hospitals - Ragama, a fully owned subsidiary of Melstacorp PLC, multi-specialty general health care facility.
Melsta Hospitals is seeking an experienced, strategic, and results-oriented finance professional to join our leadership team as Head of Finance. The successful candidate will be responsible for providing strategic financial leadership and ensuring sound financial governance, sustainability, and performance across the hospital.
Key Responsibilities
Oversee the overall financial operations of the hospital, ensuring effective financial governance and compliance with applicable standards, regulations, and company policies.
Develop and implement financial strategies to strengthen profitability, cost efficiency, and long-term financial sustainability.
Lead the annual budgeting, financial forecasting, management reporting, and financial planning processes.
Ensure compliance with taxation, statutory requirements, financial regulations, and audit requirements.
Oversee and continuously improve revenue cycle management, including billing, receivables, collections, reimbursements, and revenue assurance.
Establish and strengthen financial controls, risk management, and internal control mechanisms.
Lead and develop the Finance team, fostering a culture of accountability, accuracy, efficiency, and continuous improvement.
Liaise with auditors, banks, regulatory authorities, and other relevant external stakeholders.
Qualifications & Requirements
Fully Qualified Chartered Accountant (CA Sri Lanka) is preferred.
Minimum 8-10 years of post-qualification experience in Finance, Accounting with at least 3 years in a managerial or senior management capacity.
Experience in the healthcare/hospital industry will be an added advantage.
Strong knowledge of financial management, taxation, statutory compliance, auditing, budgeting, and financial reporting.
Proven expertise in financial planning, cost control, revenue cycle management, working capital management, and financial risk management.
Proficiency in MS Office and financial management systems/ERP platforms.
MBA / Master's Degree in Finance, Accounting, or Business Management will be an added advantage.
Location: No. 43, Mahabage Road, Ragama.
